name: Our Fate
source:
You've just found out you may have a daughter somewhere, a girl you know nothing about.
How will you react, what decisions will you make?

[From  [url=https://www.patreon.com/cedsense]Patreon[/url]]

你剛發現自己可能在某處有一個女兒，一個你一無所知的女孩。

你會如何反應，又會做出什麼決定？
